## Problem / motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it clearly.
Example: "It's frustrating when I can't do X because..."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This fits within the project scope (local/LAN file management)
